elements.name: new
elements.brief: Creates a printer instance on a gui scene that holds a printer template. The
elements.description:
Creates a printer instance on a gui scene that holds a printer template. The
module reads the template's `prefab`, `prefab_icon` and `text_parent` nodes, and
places text from the top left of `text_parent`.

parameters.name: template_name
parameters.doc: The name of the printer template in the gui scene.

elements.name: print
elements.brief: Starts printing text on an instance. Wrap a style name in braces to switch style
elements.description:
Starts printing text on an instance. Wrap a style name in braces to switch style
(`{red}`), use `{/}` to return to the default style, `{n}` for a line break and
`{image:name}` for an image.

parameters.name: source
parameters.doc: A source added with `add_source_style`. Its style is copied over the default style and becomes this text's base style, which `{/}` returns to.

returnvalues.doc: `true` when the new text starts printing; `false` when text was still printing, so the new text did not start. `print` then calls `instant_appear`, which reveals that text at once only when the effective style of the symbol currently appearing has `can_skip` set to `true`; otherwise it keeps printing.

elements.name: instant_appear
elements.brief: Makes every symbol of the current text visible at once, only when the effective
elements.description:
Makes every symbol of the current text visible at once, only when the effective
style of the symbol currently appearing has `can_skip` set to `true`; otherwise the
text keeps printing.

elements.name: fadeout
elements.brief: Stops printing and fades every symbol of the current text out over 0.3 seconds.
elements.description: Stops printing and fades every symbol of the current text out over 0.3 seconds.

elements.name: clear
elements.brief: Deletes all of the current printed text.
elements.description: Deletes all of the current printed text.

elements.name: update
elements.brief: Advances printing and the text shake. Call it from the gui script's `update`.
elements.description: Advances printing and the text shake. Call it from the gui script's `update`.

elements.name: final
elements.brief: Deletes the printed text and stops printing. Call it from the gui script's `final`.
elements.description: Deletes the printed text and stops printing. Call it from the gui script's `final`.

elements.name: play_sound
elements.brief: Called whenever a symbol with a style `sound` appears; it does nothing until a
elements.description:
Called whenever a symbol with a style `sound` appears; it does nothing until a
project replaces it with its own sound playback. A namespace import is read-only,
so assign through a cast that keeps the function free of `self`:
`(printer as { play_sound: (this: void, name: string) => void }).play_sound = (name) => { ... }`.

elements.name: add_styles
elements.brief: Adds styles to the module, shared by every instance. A style with an existing name
elements.description:
Adds styles to the module, shared by every instance. A style with an existing name
replaces it, and a style named `default` replaces the default style.

parameters.name: styles_new
parameters.doc: The styles, keyed by style name.

elements.name: add_source_style
elements.brief: Adds a source style: a `print` given this source copies the style over the default
elements.description:
Adds a source style: a `print` given this source copies the style over the default
style and uses it as the text's base style.

parameters.name: source
parameters.doc: The source name to pass to `print`.

elements.name: add_word_style
elements.brief: Adds a word style: every occurrence of the word in printed text is wrapped in the
elements.description:
Adds a word style: every occurrence of the word in printed text is wrapped in the
style, then returns to the default style. The match is case sensitive.

properties.name: is_print
properties.brief: Whether the printer is printing text now. It is unset until the first `print`,
properties.description:
Whether the printer is printing text now. It is unset until the first `print`,
`fadeout` or `final`.

properties.brief: In pixels, the height of every symbol or image. It also sets where a new line starts.
properties.description: In pixels, the height of every symbol or image. It also sets where a new line starts.

properties.name: spacing
properties.brief: In pixels, the horizontal distance between symbols.
properties.description: In pixels, the horizontal distance between symbols.

properties.name: speed
properties.brief: In seconds, the time between printing one symbol and the next.
properties.description: In seconds, the time between printing one symbol and the next.

properties.name: appear
properties.brief: In seconds, how long a symbol takes to fade in from alpha 0 to 1.
properties.description: In seconds, how long a symbol takes to fade in from alpha 0 to 1.

properties.name: shaking
properties.brief: In pixels, how far every symbol in this style shakes. `0` disables it.
properties.description: In pixels, how far every symbol in this style shakes. `0` disables it.

properties.name: shake_on_write
properties.brief: In pixels, how far the whole text shakes when a symbol in this style appears. `0` disables it.
properties.description: In pixels, how far the whole text shakes when a symbol in this style appears. `0` disables it.

properties.brief: `true` makes the symbols wave up and down.
